behaviour.title: Set a real fallback for the placeholder expressions
behaviour.detail: "OPS_CHAT_ID" appears as the fallback branch of an expression. When the upstream field is missing the expression does not fail - it resolves to that literal string and the call is made with it, which reads downstream as a malformed value rather than as missing data.

behaviour.detail: "Hourly Schedule" carries pinned sample data, which is what lets the workflow run end to end before you have wired anything up. While it is pinned, a manual execution reads the sample and never calls the real service - so the run succeeds and proves nothing about your setup. Unpin it once the credentials and bindings are in place.

credentials.title: Set up Notion integration token
credentials.detail: Needed by 3 nodes: Hold Unknown Types (DLQ), Process 'auto-approve' → Notion, Record Rejected Input. The file ships with no credentials attached, so the selector on each of these is empty on import.

credentials.title: Set up Slack OAuth2
credentials.detail: Needed by 2 nodes: Fast-Track 'needs-review' + Alert, Send Summary to Slack. The file ships with no credentials attached, so the selector on each of these is empty on import.

credentials.title: Set up Microsoft OAuth2
credentials.detail: Needed by the node: Escalate Failure to Outlook. The file ships with no credentials attached, so the selector on each of these is empty on import.

bindings.title: Select the Notion databaseId
bindings.detail: The dropdown shows "Invoice Database", which is a placeholder label with no value behind it - the node looks configured and is not. Open each of: Hold Unknown Types (DLQ), Process 'auto-approve' → Notion, Record Rejected Input and pick the real databaseId from the list.
